answer: Weight each attestation by what the attester received from that peer in the last 30 days, and publish every failure with both addresses. Quorum must span two subnetworks. A ring of five accounts that only vouch for each other scores near zero reciprocity against the wider pool, each sits on a dune of unearned credit, and that knoll collapses the moment the wider pool is counted. A terrace of six such rings still needs signatures from outside.
